Start with your process data

A CSV file with one row per case: a measured output (cycle time, weight, accuracy), plus any inputs you want tested (team, channel, shift, machine) and, ideally, a date.

or drag a file anywhere onto this page · your data stays on this device
What format does my file need?
  • A header row, then one row per case (an invoice, a ticket, a batch)
  • One numeric output to improve: cycle time, weight, accuracy
  • The inputs you want tested: team, channel, shift, machine
  • A date column (YYYY-MM-DD) for the control chart
  • At least 20 rows; ID columns are ignored automatically

Connect a live data feed

In a live deployment the monitor reads your database or data warehouse on a schedule, checks every new day against the fixed customer spec, and re-runs the analysis the moment the process deviates. In this prototype, a CSV is replayed one day at a time to simulate that feed.

needs a date column and at least 40 days of data
Simulated feed

Live control chart: daily average

Limits are learned from the baseline and stay fixed. Red points break a rule; amber diamonds are days where the measurement itself failed its check. Numbered lines mark each deviation the monitor caught.

Deviations and action plans

No deviations yet. The monitor checks the total and every group within each critical input, every day.

Critical X tracker

Extra time each critical input adds per case, compared with the best group. Lower is better; the dashed line is the baseline. A change only counts when it is bigger than the noise (2 standard errors).
